preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)
Attacker must hold some 1SHIBA tokens to trigger fee collection

exploit_hint: As owner, call setTaxFeePercent() and setLiquidityFeePercent() to set extremely high fees (e.g., 99%). Then perform token transfers to collect fees. The contract will swap tokens for BNB and send a portion to the marketing address (which could be controlled by owner). Alternatively, if marketing address is owner-controlled, directly benefit from increased fee revenue.
